title.narrative: EU Support to Municipal Finance in Turkey

description.narrative: EIB has signed two framework loans with the municipal bank of Turkey (ILBANK), which will comprise investment projects in the environmental sector throughout Turkey. This action shall provide technical assistance in order to improve the institutional capacity of ILBANK and Turkish municipalities to prepare and implement investment projects in line with acceptable standards. TheEU assistance will cover the cost othe project preparation, supervision, monitoring and capacity building activities.
